Usage

How responses are built. Response blocks are used to construct the response. There are various text blocks to represent different information; they’re built with spacings depending on the typography scale (16px between blocks). Content uses Segoe Sans (weights 420 / 550 / 625), quotes use the Georgia editorial face, and code uses Consolas — headings step 36 → 20 at weight 550 with −0.15 tracking; body paragraphs run Large 20/34, Medium 16/28, Small 12/20.
